lines.text: The psalmist calls rich and poor alike to hear his riddle, expressed with the harp.
Wicked usurpers trust in their wealth, but no man can redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
Wise men and fools die and leave their wealth to others, and their cities are their eternal homes.
The foolish are like sheep headed for Sheol with Death as their shepherd, but God will redeem the psalmist's life.
A rich man carries nothing away when he dies and joins the great kings of old.
